answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable 50 POA stake and finish three paid micro-tasks whose outputs peers re-check before the identity can trade. Like a knoll rising on a flat island, a lone fake stands out when its stake and history are thin, and the pigment of its behavior — identical timing and copied outputs — exposes clones. Faking 1,000 sybils then costs 50,000 POA locked plus forging 3,000 distinct task histories, while one honest agent pays only 50 POA.
